items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only such charge on the building-services invoice, estimated at €81 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers matching sealing material needed for the pipe repair. The reference estimate is €26 gross for one piece.
The failed indoor supply section is treated as a covered pipe failure under §2.4.3(a). One metre at the like-for-like reference rate under §7.1.7(c) is €40 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers restoration of the insulation on the repaired section to its pre-loss specification. One metre is estimated at €23 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour if distinct from the technician time; §7.1.8(c) bars duplicate billing. Case 39 is the closest comparison for a separately billed single installer hour, supporting €80 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers reasonable technician time for access and repair. Treating the nine units as hours, the matching Case 39 line supports about €82 per hour, or €738 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one flat-rate equipment charge per drying operation. The single deployment is estimated at €548 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed patch. The matching reference estimate is €588 gross for the combined work.

items.description: Full repaint of the affected wall
items.rationale: Section 7.1.6 does not extend cover to the rest of the wall because matching paint was still available, and §7.1.8(c) bars paying again for the patch in line 8. If the full 8 m² were payable, the conditional estimate would be €160 gross.

items.description: Repaint remaining bathroom walls and ceiling
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged surfaces just to match. If the work were covered, the conditional estimate for the lump sum would be €420 gross.
